Looking at this crop:

**(1) Is the complete Celsius wind icon (all three curved lines) visible?**
**No.** The top curved line is partially cut off at the upper edge of the image. Only about 2/3 of that line is visible, while the middle and bottom lines are fully visible.

**(2) Is the 'Celsius' wordmark fully readable?**
**Yes.** The entire word "Celsius" is clearly legible with all letters fully contained within the frame.

**(3) Quality 1-10?**
**8/10.** The image has excellent sharpness, high contrast, and clean edges on the text and logo elements. The only deduction is for the slight cropping of the top wind line, which makes this an incomplete logo capture despite the otherwise pristine quality of what *is* visible.
